sources.entry: Soda – Knowledge layer for customer-facing teams. A living memory built from every call, app and conversation.

summary.name: Soda
summary.one_liner: Soda is a Mac-based AI memory layer for customer-facing teams that listens to calls and conversations, extracts facts about customers and contacts, and lets you query them later.
use_cases: Recalling pricing or commitments agreed on a previous call
Preparing for a customer renewal using onboarding history
Handing over customer context from sales to customer success
Tracking changes in customer contacts and roles
Mapping who knows who across customer accounts
Keeping CRM-style notes updated without manual logging
summary.what_it_does: Soda listens to calls on supported meeting platforms, transcribes audio on the user's device, and builds living profiles for customers, prospects and partners. It extracts structured facts, keeps them current when details change, and retains full history rather than overwriting. Each fact links back to the moment it was captured, including the words used and the source call. Customer profiles can be shared across an account team, and the app highlights what has changed on each profile. Users can ask questions from anywhere on their Mac via a ⌘⌘ shortcut, and connect a calendar (up to 10) so the relevant profile is ready before the next meeting.
notable: On-device transcription: call audio is processed locally on the Mac and not stored in the cloud
Facts traceable to the exact source moment, with full history kept when facts change
Per-platform control over which meeting apps Soda listens to, plus a pause button
Optional AI notepad that enriches shorthand notes with call context
caveats: Calendar connections are capped at 10; more requires contacting the company
Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
Mac-only as described on the page; ⌘⌘ shortcut is described for Mac
